title: foundrShiny Developer Guide
text: Explicit Package Namespacing: Use pkg::func() imported functions (e.g., shiny::moduleServer(), ggplot2::ggplot(), dplyr::filter()) prevent namespace collisions. Explicit Package Imports (Meta-Packages): Avoid meta-packages like library(tidyverse) vignettes, source functions, test scripts. Use explicit package imports (library(dplyr), library(ggplot2), etc.) minimize dependency overhead prevent build failures. Safe Vector Subsetting R: stripping filtering R comments, ALWAYS use grepl("^\\s*#'", lines) !grepl(...) grep(..., invert = TRUE). Avoid using !grep(...) can evaluate logical FALSE unexpectedly empty atomic vectors character(0). Roxygen Documentation: Document exported functions using #' blocks R/*.R files maintain clear parameter descriptions. Verification: Run devtools::check() locally submitting pull requests preparing package releases.

title: foundrShiny Module Index & Design Conventions
text: foundrShiny strictly adheres Mastering Shiny Module Conventions. Every component file R/ defines 5 standard exported functions: [!NOTE] Terminology Distinction: Shiny Modules vs. WGCNA Trait Modules foundrShiny, term module used two distinct contexts: 1. Shiny Modules: Encapsulated UI, server logic, reactive state functions constructed using Shiny’s moduleServer() (e.g., contrastGroupServer, traitServer). 2. WGCNA Trait Modules: Statistical groupings correlated phenotypic traits identified via weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA). contrastGroupApp.R Shiny module specifically visualizes WGCNA eigentraits (eigens()) individual traits (traits()) belonging WGCNA modules.
